applicabilityBasis.summary: GHO is a prominent dollar-denominated stablecoin used in Aave liquidity and collateral flows, but it is overcollateralized, minted and burned through Aave DAO-authorized facilitators, and does not present a resolved legal issuer or fixed-value payment-issuer pathway. Those facts make its GENIUS payment-stablecoin classification materially uncertain.

genius.notes: GHO was assessed explicitly because its name, dollar peg, and stablecoin use make it confusable with a GENIUS payment stablecoin. The record is conservative: no public qualifying GENIUS approval or issuer-specific application was located in the reviewed federal materials, but the decentralized DAO/facilitator model leaves applicability unresolved.
